files.description: Playwright tests for the Remove Duplicates utility: directory selection + scan, group review with keep-toggling and pagination that preserves selections, trash/move action switching with destination input, and executing a move-to-folder removal verified on the filesystem.

testContext: /utilities/remove-duplicates starts with no directory rows ('No directory selected'): click #add-directory-button (HTMX swaps #remove-duplicates-form) to add one, fill input[name=directory], and dispatch a 'change' event explicitly (hx-trigger=change; blur alone is unreliable under automation) to rescan the media count ('Total Media' .stat-card). #find-duplicates-button POSTs /start (202) and the page reloads; the response body is dropped by the reload, so read the new job id by DIFFING #job-progress-section [id^=job-] card ids before/after — COMPLETED find_duplicates jobs from earlier runs linger on this page and .last() picks the wrong one. Grouping is by EXACT perceptual hash (imagehash.phash): visually identical files group together regardless of byte differences, so the test corpus is generated as per-group random-noise JPEGs via the server venv's Python/PIL (../venv/bin/python), each copied once → exactly N pairs. Results page /results/<job_id>: #duplicates-form + #duplicates-header stats ('Total Media Processed'/'Duplicate Groups Found'/'Duplicates Selected'), .duplicate-group blocks with .photo-card tiles (first card kept/unselected, rest .selected); clicking a card HTMX-toggles it and OOB-updates the header. Pagination (12 groups @ page size 10): .page-navigation .page-btn Next/First, .page-info 'Page X of Y'; selections ride hidden selected_photo inputs in the form and survive paging. #action-type is a searchable-select (trash|moveFolder|delete); moveFolder reveals #destination-folder. Execute (.btn-danger 'Remove Selected Duplicates') posts /execute/<job_id> — NOTE: the app shows NO confirmation dialog before this destructive action (spec gap, flagged); the success toast is wiped immediately by HX-Redirect, so assert the redirect and the moved files on disk (fs.readdirSync of the scratch dest/scan dirs) instead. The suite builds everything under the sandbox root (derived from Settings' Database Path) and rm -rf's it in afterAll; the seeded library is never scanned or modified.
explanation: Generated manually from specs/remove_duplicates.yaml after inspecting templates/utilities/remove_duplicates*.html, routes/utilities/remove_duplicates.py, static/utilities/remove_duplicates.js, background_tasks/tasks/find_duplicates.py (phash grouping), components/htmx_pagination.html, and fragments/job_status_fragment.html. Iterations fixed: corpus must be visually distinct per group (phash), the add-directory row must be created first, change events need explicit dispatch, the start response body is lost to the reload (job-card id diff instead), and the execute toast is unassertable past the HX-Redirect. Validated with typecheck and a green run (4/4) against the isolated environment.
